Dialogs.Text: Four kobolds have taken over Cave A in the Caves of Chaos. Leave by the south gate, follow the Borderlands trail northeast, and enter the ravine. Clear their lair and return for your reward.
Leave by the south gate and follow the trail northeast to the Caves of Chaos. In the ravine, Cave A is the first mouth on the northern ledge. Return here after defeating its four kobolds.
The entrance is clear! Thank you. Here is the reward I promised.
The road is safer thanks to you. You are welcome at the Keep.
Four kobolds block the chamber. They clutch their weapons and refuse to move.
